class.name: FellowInertializer3D
class.brief_description: Hides an animation's switch to another: the pose the character had, carried on by its own velocity, blended to the new animation's (inertialization by dead blending). FellowEngine.
class.description: A [SkeletonModifier3D] for animation transitions. Instead of a cross-fade, which evaluates both animations for its whole length and mixes their poses (feet sliding, a jolt in the bones' speed at its start), switch the animation at once — [method AnimationPlayer.play] with [code]custom_blend[/code] [code]0.0[/code], an [AnimationTree]'s transitions with no cross-fade — and let this node, a child of the [Skeleton3D], blend over [member blend_time] from the last pose drawn, carried on by the velocity it had and slowing ([member extrapolation_halflife]), to the new animation's pose. Only the new animation is evaluated meanwhile (Holden's "dead blending", 2023, an inertialization). A blend starts when [method blend] is called, when the [AnimationMixer] at [member animation_mixer_path] emits [signal AnimationMixer.animation_started], or, with [member detect_jumps], when a bone turns further in a frame than its velocity carries it. Over 120 random switches between 128 CMU mocap clips (FellowEngine's [code]benchmarks/tools/animation_transitions[/code]), against [AnimationPlayer]'s cross-fade of the same 0.25 s: the bones' angular acceleration's median is 41 % lower and its 95th percentile 17 %, the feet planted in the new animation slide 10 % less (0.95 m/s against 1.06; 26 % less with a [FellowFootLock3D] after this node), and the player evaluates one animation instead of two (its time 6.2 µs against 9.2, the modifier 2.8 µs; 31 bones).

method.name: blend
method.description: Starts a blend from the pose last drawn to the animation's, over [param seconds] ([member blend_time] if negative). Call it in the frame the animation switches (before or after [method AnimationPlayer.play]). A blend started during another starts from the pose that one had reached, with its velocity.

method.name: get_blend_progress
method.description: How far the current blend has gone, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]; [code]1.0[/code] when not blending.

method.name: get_stats
method.description: [code]frames[/code] (the modifier's passes), [code]blends[/code] (started), [code]usec_per_frame[/code] (its mean CPU time a pass).

method.name: is_blending
method.description: Whether a blend is under way.

members.member: An [AnimationPlayer] or [AnimationTree] whose [signal AnimationMixer.animation_started] starts a blend: its animations switched at once are blended by this node with no code. Leave its own cross-fades at [code]0.0[/code].
The blends' length in seconds (a smoothstep from the carried-on old pose to the new animation's).

If [code]true[/code], a blend also starts when a bone of the new pose has turned more than [member jump_angle] further than its last velocity would have turned it in the frame: switches no signal announces (a script setting bone poses, a state machine's instant transitions) are hidden too. A fast motion may start blends of its own.

While blending, the old pose carries on with the velocities it had, which halve every this many seconds. Small values hold the old pose still as it fades (measured: slightly less foot sliding, larger single jumps); larger ones carry its motion on further.
